instruction: A German company that is internationally leading in endoscopy was founded as a two-person operation in the town regarded as the world centre of medical technology. Name the surgical-instruments manufacturer headquartered in that same town that belongs to the B. Braun group.

provenance.difficulty_axis: 3 sources; runtime-dependent (the town discovered via the endoscopy leader determines the second-company query)

verification.one_shot_breaks: candidate-breaks (second company only findable once Tuttlingen is known; short-circuit risk: 'B. Braun surgical subsidiary' -> Aesculap directly -> confirm via one-shot-break check)

provenance.note: Cluster chain: endoscopy leader -> Karl Storz/Tuttlingen -> B. Braun surgical-instruments co there -> Aesculap.
